adaptations.reason: documents package-relative layout tools and actual scorecard arguments under human graph control.
scorecard guidance uses actual local tool paths and keeps scoring advisory.
documents package-relative tools and explicit configured vault selection.
Obsidian projection requires a selected vault and explicit write scope, without global discovery or setup commands.
source metadata uses package-relative tool paths; upstream service observations remain advisory.
issue dispositions describe semantic revision work; graph control and procedure activation belong to Navigate and the CLI.
claim-chart inputs and bounded semantic completion use the active procedure packet and ordinary project files.
documents the explicitly scoped local case-history helper and the shipped Word and Excel tools.
the environment probe points at a configured CadQuery environment instead of a removed installer.
the dependency report describes a configured CadQuery environment instead of a removed installer.
STEP view rendering never bootstraps cad-env automatically; a missing cad-env is reported as not_ready so the semantic pipeline runs against a configured environment.
the module is a configured-local reader: it never downloads, mutates the process environment, or writes to or deletes from configured model directories.
the cache root comes from explicit configuration or the current project directory instead of operating-system document discovery.
notes are read from an explicit frozen corpus directory or an explicit file index and are bounded in count and size; whole-vault discovery is removed.
the map serves an explicit corpus directory or an explicit file index instead of an implied Obsidian vault scan.
IPC subclass titles are read from an explicitly configured CSV; no repository data file is required.
the Obsidian vault is resolved only from an explicit path or environment variable; operating-system and persisted global discovery is removed.
reports only the selected vault without installing software, discovering global vaults or persisting configuration.
an explicit --vault path takes precedence over environment configuration for user-selected note, Canvas, Base and glossary projection.
uses a configured local model and reports missing prerequisites honestly, with IPC fallback.
